description: Action with an empty-object member. Composition 6.3.2 specifies SHA-256(JCS(action)) — plain RFC 8785 — which retains empty objects in the canonical form. Prior to the jcs registry entry, CPB's Canonicalization Algorithm Registry had no entry for that construction — only jcs-n, which removes empty-object members via the normalization pass (E3). The two constructions produce different bytes and different digests for the same action. Note that the jcs-n digest is identical to diff-01 (both actions strip to the same two-member object) while the plain-JCS digests differ — confirming that both sources of divergence are real and independent.
